question: Vote with one's pocketbook
options: To keep money inside a small notebook
To lose your wallet while shopping
To be very greedy for wealth and assets
To express preferences through spending or financial decisions
solution: Consumers are voting with their pocketbooks by choosing eco-friendly products. अपने पैसे खर्च करने के तरीके या वित्तीय फैसलों के ज़रिए अपनी राय या पसंद ज़ाहिर करना।

question: Vicious cycle
options: To be very lucky in every situation
A situation where problems cause more problems
To follow a very healthy daily routine
To ride a bicycle in a dangerous way
solution: Poverty is often a vicious cycle that is hard to break. एक ऐसा दुष्चक्र जहाँ एक समस्या दूसरी बड़ी समस्या को जन्म देती है और स्थिति बिगड़ती जाती है।

question: Vexed question
options: A question about the future of the world
A difficult question discussed a lot without resolution
A question asked by a teacher in class
A very easy and simple question
solution: The issue of the disputed land remains a vexed question for the government. एक ऐसा जटिल या विवादास्पद मुद्दा जिस पर बहुत चर्चा हुई हो पर कोई समाधान न निकला हो।

question: Vent one's spleen
options: To hide your true feelings from others
To be very kind to everyone around
To have a surgery of the internal organs
To express anger or frustration
solution: He used the press conference to vent his spleen against the critics. अपनी भड़ास निकालना या अपना सारा गुस्सा और हताशा बाहर निकालना।

question: Vote with one's feet
options: To support someone's decision blindly
To walk all the way to the polling booth
To dance to celebrate an election win
To show disapproval by leaving
solution: Many people voted with their feet and left the country during the crisis. किसी चीज़ के प्रति अपनी असहमति जताने के लिए उस स्थान को छोड़कर चले जाना।

question: Vanish into thin air
options: To disappear suddenly and completely
To become very thin due to illness
To travel by air to a distant place
To feel very light and happy
solution: The thief seemed to vanish into thin air as soon as he saw the police. इसका अर्थ है अचानक और पूरी तरह से गायब या चंपत हो जाना।

question: Verbal diarrhoea
options: To speak very clearly and fluently
To have a physical illness of the throat
The tendency to talk too much, often without substance
To be very quiet and reserved in public
solution: We couldn't enjoy the movie because of his constant verbal diarrhoea. बिना किसी ठोस बात के बहुत ज़्यादा या अत्यधिक बातचीत करने की प्रवृत्ति।

question: Van Gogh's ear for music
options: To love listening to heavy metal music
To be a very talented and famous musician
To be a famous painter with a hobby of music
To be tone-deaf or have no musical ability at all
solution: Don't ask him to lead the choir; he has Van Gogh's ear for music. संगीत की बिल्कुल भी समझ न होना (यह मुहावरा मज़ाक में इस्तेमाल किया जाता है)।
